[Skilled Swimmer](/Feats.aspx?ID=5285) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Athamaru" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=741" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 20

</column>

---

You move through the water with ease, mastering your movements with years of practice. When in an aquatic environment, you ignore [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453). In addition, swimming up or down isn't difficult terrain for you.
